data.title: 娜娜 · 旧车站的回程票
data.description: 公园的环线小火车即将收班。娜娜蹲到售票机出纸口旁，捏住那张迟迟不肯吐完的小票，另一只手压住桌边的折页地图。暗红背心和牛仔短裤的黄色线脚迎着斜阳，她踮了踮鞋尖，等机器把票推到手里。
data.location: 公园环线小火车售票处
data.action: 蹲在售票机旁接住票，另一手压住折页地图
data.lighting: 低处的橙色阳光掠过售票机侧板和鞋尖
data.promptProse: Nana crouches beside the ticket machine at a small park railway as the last orange light glances off its side panel. She catches the printed ticket with one hand and pins a folded map to the ledge with the other. Yellow stitching stands out on her faded denim cutoffs below a crimson cotton tank, and white canvas sneakers tip forward as she balances.
data.animaCaption: She catches the ticket as it curls out of the slot, keeping the folded map flat with her other palm.
